name: 111 會考模擬二模（康軒 1～3 冊）英語閱讀
source: 康軒 111 學年國中教育會考模擬測驗（九年級，範圍 1～3 冊），答案與解析取自官方詳解
passages:
Zoe: I went to the best wedding ever last weekend. Look at this photo.
Alan: Hmm. The bride is beautiful, but... how old is she?
Zoe: Well, she’s turning 62 this August. In fact, she’s my mom.
Alan: What? That’s great! She finally met the right person. Your father left you when you were only 8, right?
Zoe: Right. I was so angry with him then. But everything is different now because he’s back.
Alan: What does that mean?
Zoe: 【Look at the groom】. He is my father, George.
Alan: Wow! I can’t believe it! You went to your parents’ wedding.
Zoe: That’s right. I’m so happy for them. They fought a lot in the past, but they don’t do that now.
Alan: Why didn’t you tell us the good news?
Zoe: I didn’t know about it until last month. My dad called my mom about two years ago. They began going out for dinner and movies then, but they kept it a secret from me. Isn’t it crazy to get married again after more than twenty years?
Alan: Ha! I’m so happy for your family.
（wedding 婚禮　bride 新娘　secret 祕密）

Chinese numbers are like math.
One line for one,
Two lines for two,
Three lines for three,
A box with eyebrows for four.
Hmm, now I’m lost.

Chinese words are like art.
Draw the characters for the sun, the moon, and a person.
But,
The ball doesn’t look like a ball,
Snow doesn’t look like snow.
Well, I need some answers.

Chinese sounds are like music.
【Tones】 are the soul of the language.
But please teach me to tell,
A fish and rain,
A mom and a horse,
A book and a tree.
A tree sounds like an angry book.

Strange, interesting, and beautiful,
I can’t wait to learn more.
（eyebrow 眉毛　character 字　soul 靈魂）

【Angel】
In today’s world, people do many things with the Internet. For example, people send e-mails and pay with online banking. Each person has about seven accounts for different things. What’s more, people upload photos or videos to Facebook, Instagram, and so on. As people spend more time on the Internet, a 【question】 becomes more and more important—_____ You may not want people to keep seeing your photos and videos on the Internet. You may want someone to help you take care of your Facebook account. And how do you want people to remember you when you are not in this world?
If you care about any of the above, let Angel help you.

Angel’s Services—After you pass away...
・We help you delete any of your accounts.
・We help you cancel any of your subscriptions.
・We help you send e-mails, photos, or videos.
　For example, some grandparents ask us to send birthday cards to their grandchildren every year after they pass away.

With $10 a month, Angel will help you a lot in the future.
（online banking 網路銀行服務　account 帳號　delete 刪除　cancel 取消　subscription 訂閱）

（白蟻生命週期圖，見附圖）
1 A termite family starts with a king and a queen.
2 Eggs become nymphs. We can understand nymphs as very young termites.
3 Nymphs become workers, soldiers, and reproductives. (worker: “We build houses and feed babies.” soldier: “We stop anyone from attacking the family.”)
4 Reproductives become alates. They are termites with wings, and they can fly.
5 Alates lose their wings after they swarm. A pair of dealates can become the king and the queen of a new family.

Swarm: Alates swarm during the rainy season. They fly away from their homes, and we can see groups of alates flying in the sky. They swarm from about 6 to 10 p.m. between April and July. Sadly, most alates die after they swarm. Only a few stay alive.
（termite 白蟻　wing 翅膀　alive 活著的）

This month, a strange video showed up on YouTube. In the video, a man went to a small town in Japan. He soon found the town terrible. There were zombies all over the place. He wanted to get away, but he couldn’t because there were too many zombies. He hid in a house and made this video. He explained the ways to stay safe. “When the zombies get close, try not to move. And don’t make any noise because they can hear everything,” he said.
In fact, the video is about the zombie camp in Matsuzaki, a small town in Japan. Only about 6,000 people live in Matsuzaki now. People there hold the camp to draw more people to visit their beautiful town. Besides, the visitors can scare away wild animals as well. That way, they don’t eat up their important plants—Sakura Mochi Leaves.

【Zombie Camp】
Most people in Matsuzaki got infected and turned into zombies!
Why did they get infected?
Can you find out the answer to save everyone in this town?
Place: Hennamura Camp, Matsuzaki
Time: Every weekend in August: 8/6～8/7、8/13～8/14、8/20～8/21、8/27～8/28
Price: ¥25,000 / each person
* Up to 100 people for each camp
* Only people between the ages of 20 and 40 can join
Go to Matsuzakizombie.com.jp to sign up now!
（zombie 殭屍　besides 此外　scare away 把……嚇跑　wild 野生的　infected 受感染的）

Dr. Green works in Peterson Hospital. He is always happy to answer people’s questions about health. These days, people often get knowledge through the Internet. However, not everything on the Internet is correct. Last week, Sandra showed him an article on the Internet, and she wanted to know his ideas about it. Below is the article.

【Before a Meal】 Eating some fruit before a meal can help you eat less during the meal. However, don’t eat tomatoes or oranges before a meal. It’s not good for your stomach.
【After a Meal】 Eating fruit after a meal can help with digestion. Papayas and guavas are great choices. But if you are already full, don’t eat too much fruit.
【Between Meals】 You may feel hungry in the afternoon. In that case, you can eat some fruit. Having some fruit between meals can help you stay away from cookies or cakes.
【Before Bed】 Some people like to eat bananas before bed because they help keep cramps away. But eating fruit at this time will make you become heavier, so be careful and eat the right fruit.
Read more

Dr. Green thought Sandra was a little too heavy for her age, so eating fruit too often was not good for her. She should listen to her own body and not just follow tips on the Internet.
（article 文章　digestion 消化　cramp 抽筋）

Dear Mom,
Thank you for the Coco recipe. The delicious small cake saved my business. People are crazy about it, and I’m selling a lot now. In fact, I might have too many customers.
We open at 9 a.m., but people start to wait in line for Coco at about 8. When the line gets long, some people have to stand in front of Lala. Mr. Hall, the shopkeeper of Lala, is not happy about this. In his eyes, the long line blocks his way and makes him lose customers. Well, I visited his store once. He is losing customers because his store is dark and dirty, not because of me or my customers. “Try to make your store brighter. Then when people are here for Coco, they might want to walk into your store too,” I told him. That made things worse. The next day, he even shouted at my customers and asked them to leave. Because of him, sometimes my customers have to stand in the middle of the road, and that is very dangerous. What’s more, people in line sometimes fight with one another, and the noise makes Mr. Hall even angrier. Are there any ways to bake Coco faster? I really can’t let things go on like this. :(
Love,
Becky
（recipe 食譜　customer 顧客）

Sussex News
By Karen Frank
Thursday, August 12, 2021

Alan Slattery, 67, will spend the next six years in prison. Earlier this year, Slattery attempted to rob three banks in two weeks.
On March 18, 2021, Slattery first robbed a bank in Eastbourne. At around 11 a.m., he __40__ the bank and gave the cashiers a note. __41__ He wanted to use the note to ask the cashiers to hand over money. However, no one followed Slattery’s order. In fact, because of Slattery’s poor handwriting, nobody __42__ the note. In the end, Slattery left without getting any money. “We didn’t even know he was trying to rob us,” a cashier told the police later that day __43__.
Just over a week later, Slattery successfully left with £2,400 from a Nationwide Building Society bank. Then on April 1, Slattery robbed the NatWest bank in Hastings. However, he didn’t get any money this time. Soon after NatWest called the police, they finally caught Slattery near his house.
（附圖為 Slattery 字跡潦草的紙條）
（prison 監獄　attempt 試圖　rob 搶劫　cashier 行員　handwriting 字跡）

questions.q: Look at the picture. The boy is walking to the _____ of the classroom.
questions.e: 由圖可知，小男孩正走向教室的「角落」。

questions.q:
Miles: Cora, this is Daniel. Do you _____ him?
Cora: Of course. He was your high school classmate, right?
questions.e: 由 Cora 描述自己對 Daniel 的認識，可知 Miles 是問 Cora 是否「記得」Daniel。

questions.q: Your mother is sleeping in her room. Let’s _____ into it now. I don’t want to wake her up.
questions.e: Let’s 祈使句的句型為「Let’s＋（not＋）原形動詞…」。

questions.q: _____ is exciting for Maya to go hiking with her friends, but Isaac likes to go on his own.
questions.e: 本題為虛主詞 it 句型，用虛主詞 it 代替後面的真主詞 to go hiking with her friends。

questions.q: Don’t buy the refrigerator. It’s too _____. There might be something wrong with it.
questions.e: 由「不要買這冰箱」、「它可能有什麼不對勁」，可知可能是太「便宜」了。

questions.q: The new department store is five blocks away from my house. I have to go there _____ motorcycle.
questions.e: 表達如何去某處，用「go＋（to＋）地方＋by＋交通工具」。

questions.q: My sons don’t like chocolate. They never eat anything with chocolate in it, but my daughter _____.
questions.e: my daughter 為第三人稱單數，故用助動詞 does 代替前半句提過的動詞片語。

questions.q: When Gina first moved to the USA, she _____ many problems. She had no friends, and she couldn’t get a job.
questions.e: 由「沒有朋友，並且找不到工作」，可知 Gina「經歷」了許多困難。

questions.q: Claire is not good at English. Answering a question in English is _____ for her.
questions.e: 由「不擅長英語」，可知用英語回答問題對 Claire 來說是「困難的」。

questions.q: Because Melissa wants to be a famous writer, she reads and writes a lot to follow her _____.
questions.e: 因為想要當有名的作家，而大量閱讀及寫作，可知是要追求「夢想」。

questions.q: It _____ me two hundred dollars to send this package. It was more expensive than I thought.
questions.e: 本句句型為「It＋cost＋人＋金錢＋to V...」，表示事物「花費」多少錢，用動詞 cost。

questions.q: There _____ a music festival in our town, and we will see a lot of great singers then.
questions.e: 「there＋be 動詞」為存在句，且由「屆時將會看到很多很棒的歌手」，可知應用未來式，且 music festival 為單數，故選 is going to be。

questions.q:
Nick: I can’t lose this job.
Sam: I know, but health is _____ important. You can’t stay up every night like this.
questions.e: 由 Sam 說 Nick 不能每晚像這樣熬夜，可知他認為健康「也」很重要。

questions.q: My parents _____ a funny TV show when Tommy dropped the glass. They didn’t hear that because the TV was too loud.
questions.e: 「當 Tommy 掉落杯子時」為過去某特定時間點，當時正在進行的動作應用過去進行式，且 parents 為複數，故選 were watching。

questions.q:
Kyle: _____ do you see Peter walking his dog?
Anna: Almost every day. He usually walks it for thirty minutes after dinner.
questions.e: 由 Anna 回答「幾乎每天」，可知 Kyle 是問頻率，應用 How often。

questions.q:
Luna: What’s so _____ about the ice cream here?
Eva: They make the ice cream in the shape of animals, and each part of it tastes different.
questions.e: 由「把冰淇淋做成動物的形狀，並且每個部分嘗起來都不同」，可知是問冰淇淋有什麼「特別的」。

questions.q: I thought about _____ my daughter a new desk, but she really liked the old one.
questions.e: 介系詞後方接動作時，應用動名詞 V-ing 的形式。

questions.q: My grandpa went to that _____ very often. However, he did not go there to pray. He just liked talking with his friends there.
questions.e: 由「不是去那裡祈求」，可知應該選「寺廟」。

questions.q: Karen’s husband is going on a business trip to Japan. Dressing well is important, so she has to shop for her husband. Which floor of the department store should she go to?
questions.e: 由「穿著得體是很重要的」，可知 Karen 應會到「四樓男裝部」幫丈夫買一些衣服。

questions.q:
While reading a piece of news, Gabriel saw the word “adopt” and didn’t understand it.
“... At first, Dr. Wilson did not want to adopt Mr. Clark’s Eagle T because it was not good enough. However, Mr. Clark’s hard work caught his eye. He finally made up his mind to adopt the plan...”
He found several meanings of the word in a dictionary. What does “adopt” mean here?
o: To take someone else’s child into one’s own family.
To use a different way of speaking.
To choose a new country to live in.
To start to use something new.
questions.e: 由首句雖無法得知 Clark 先生的 Eagle T 是什麼，但由後方描述「Clark 先生的努力吸引了 Wilson 博士的目光」及「他終於下定決心 adopt 此計畫」，可知 adopt 在此是表「採用」，選項(D)最符合其意。

questions.q: Who was Zoe pointing at when she said “Look at the groom”?（選項見圖）
questions.e: 因 Zoe 是去參加自己父母親的婚禮，且由後句「他是我爸爸」，可知她說這句話時應是指著「新郎」，故選(B)。

questions.q: Which is NOT true about Zoe’s mother?
o: She just got married last weekend.
She often fought with her husband before.
She always shares everything with Zoe.
questions.e: 由 Zoe 直到上個月才知道她父母親要再次結婚，且他們對於約會的事情保密，可知她媽媽並非總是與她分享每件事，故選(D)。

questions.q: What can we learn from the dialogue?（dialogue 對話）
o: Zoe’s parents started going out again about two years ago.
Zoe helped her parents get back together.
Zoe’s father left the family when she was a teenager.
Alan knew nothing about Zoe’s family.
questions.e: 由倒數第三、四行可知 Zoe 的父母親大約兩年前再度開始出去吃晚餐看電影，故選(A)。

questions.q: Which is NOT true about the poem?（poem 詩）
o: The writer wants to keep learning.
The language is easy for the writer.
questions.e:
作者提到自己「迷惘了」、「需要些答案」及「請教我分辨」，可知中文對他來說並不簡單，故選(D)。
【中譯】中文數字就像數學。一條線是一，兩條線是二，三條線是三，一個有眉毛的盒子是四。呃，現在我迷惘了。中文字就像藝術。畫出代表太陽、月亮和人的字。但是，球看起來不像球，雪看起來不像雪。嗯，我需要些答案。中文聲音就像音樂。聲調是這語言的靈魂。但請教我分辨，魚和雨、媽和馬、書和樹。樹聽起來像一本生氣的書。奇怪、有趣又美麗，我等不及要學更多。

questions.q: Which shows the tone?（選項見圖）
questions.e: 由本段作者要人教自己分辨「魚和雨」、「媽和馬」、「書和樹」，又說「樹聽起來像一本生氣的書」，可知 tone 指的是中文的聲調，故選(C)。

questions.q: What might the question be?
o: What will happen to your accounts, photos, and videos after you pass away?
Why do you like Angel’s services so much and want people to know about it?
What would you like to tell your family and friends when you are dying?
What is your favorite thing to do when you’re surfing the Internet?
questions.e: 由後方「您可能不希望人們在網際網路上持續看到您的照片和影片」、「您可能會希望有人幫您處理您的 Facebook 帳號」及「當您不在這世界上了，您希望人們如何記得您」，可知該問題應是「您去世後，您的帳號、照片和影片會怎麼樣呢？」，故選(A)。

questions.q: What can we learn from the reading?
o: Angel only helps people over seventy years old.
Everyone has about seven online friends.
People can use Angel for free for the first time.
Angel can help people delete their e-mail accounts.
questions.e: 由 Angel 的服務項目可知，他們可以幫助人們刪除任何帳號，故可刪除電子郵件帳號，故選(D)。

questions.q: Who might want to try Angel’s services?
o: Nathan. He is too busy and needs a secretary to help him with e-mails.
Jack. He wants to delete his Facebook account because he has a new one.
Ava. She doesn’t want anyone to visit her Facebook page after she passes away.
Ellie. She doesn’t have an online bank account and wants to have one.
questions.e: Angel 提供的是人們去世後的網路服務，故會感興趣的應是不希望任何人在她去世後瀏覽她 Facebook 頁面的 Ava，故選(C)。

questions.q: Elisa saw many termites flying in the yard. What month might it be?
questions.e: 白蟻群飛的季節是每年四月到七月間，故選(D)。

questions.q: Which is true about termites?
o: Both workers and soldiers can fly in the rainy season.
Workers can’t turn into the king or the queen.
Most nymphs die after they swarm.
The king and the queen have to feed nymphs.
questions.e: (A)工蟻和兵蟻都不會飛；(C)若蟲不會群飛；(D)若蟲是由工蟻餵食；僅(B)正確，故選(B)。

questions.q: Which is true about the number of members in a termite family?
questions.e: (A)大多數有翅繁殖蟻在群飛後死亡，故脫翅繁殖蟻數量應小於有翅繁殖蟻，而有翅繁殖蟻數量應小於若蟲；(B)若蟲數量應大於工蟻和兵蟻；(D)有翅繁殖蟻數量應大於脫翅繁殖蟻，脫翅繁殖蟻數量應大於蟻王；僅(C)正確，故選(C)。

questions.q: What do people need to find out in the camp to save everyone?
o: How can they scare away the wild animals?
How can they kill more zombies?
Are there any zombies in this town?
questions.e: 由海報內容的第二～三句可知，需要找出為什麼小鎮的人們受到感染，故選(C)。

questions.q: Why do people in Matsuzaki hold the zombie camp?
o: They need money to scare away the wild animals.
They are too afraid of real zombies.
They need people to help them scare away zombies.
They want more people to visit their beautiful town.
questions.e: 由第二段第三句可知，舉辦殭屍營是為了吸引更多人拜訪他們的美麗小鎮，故選(D)。

questions.q: What CAN’T we learn from the reading?
o: The man in the video knew the ways to stay safe.
People can call to sign up for the camp.
People under twenty can’t join the camp.
Each person has to pay ¥25,000 to join the camp.
questions.e: 海報中只提到要去網站報名，沒有提到可致電報名，故選(B)。

questions.q: What might be the title of the article on the Internet?（title 標題）
o: Go to Bed at the Right Time.
How to Prepare a Fruit Meal.
questions.e: 此篇網路文章分析了四個吃水果的時間點，故標題可能為「在不同時間點吃水果」，故選(C)。

questions.q: What can we learn from the article on the Internet?
o: Eating fruit before a meal might make people become heavier.
Eating fruit when you feel hungry between meals is a good idea.
Tomatoes and oranges can help with digestion.
Eating fruit right after you wake up is the best.
questions.e: 根據此篇網路文章：(A)只提到餐前吃水果可以讓人在用餐時少吃點東西；(C)提到餐後吃水果能幫助消化，木瓜和芭樂是很棒的選擇，並非番茄和柳橙；(D)未提到起床後立刻吃水果是最好的；僅(B)符合文章描述，故選(B)。

questions.q: What did Dr. Green probably say to Sandra?
o: “Thank you for the article. It’s helpful for everyone.”
“Eat more fruit. The sugar inside is good for you.”
“The article is OK, but having your own fruit plan would be better.”
“Have an apple before bed, and you won’t get cramps so often.”
questions.e: 由 Green 醫師認為 Sandra 應該聆聽自己的身體，而不是只遵從網路上的祕訣，可知他較可能要 Sandra 擁有自己的水果計畫，故選(C)。

questions.q: Hank was passing by Becky’s store at about 8:30 this morning. What did he probably see?（選項見圖）
questions.e: 早上八點半 Becky 的店已會有排隊人潮，但店還沒開，故選(C)。

questions.q: Which is NOT one of Becky’s problems?
o: Her store is dark and dirty, so she is losing customers.
Mr. Hall is angry with her customers.
She can’t bake Coco fast enough for her customers.
questions.e: 因為店又暗又髒而流失顧客的是 Hall 先生，不是 Becky，故選(A)。

questions.q: 第 40 題空格應填入：
questions.e: 描述在過去時間點「進入」銀行的瞬間動作，用過去簡單式，故選(B)。

questions.q: 第 41 題空格應填入：
o: They really needed the note then.
It was a short story about a bank.
Slattery wrote the note by himself.
And again, Slattery took his money back.
questions.e: 由後文線索「他想用這張紙條要求行員交出錢。然而，沒有人遵從 Slattery 的指示」，可知本句最符合的答案為「Slattery 自己寫了這張紙條」，故選(C)。

questions.q: 第 42 題空格應填入：
questions.e: 全文描述過去發生的事，表「能」看懂要用助動詞 can，而過去式為 could，故選(A)。

questions.q: 第 43 題空格應填入：
o: when she ran away from the bank
because she had to get the money back
because she didn’t want to go to prison
when she was finally able to read the note
questions.e: 由「沒有人能看懂這張紙條」、「甚至不知道他正試著搶劫我們」，可知 Slattery 至銀行搶劫時，行員都看不懂紙條，而是當天稍晚才「終於能看懂這張紙條」。(A)行員不用逃離銀行；(B)Slattery 沒有拿到任何錢，所以行員不用把錢拿回來；(C)行員不會去坐牢；故選(D)。
